segments.name: EV Charging
segments.description: Builds, owns and operates public EV fast charging stations and sells charging and related software services to drivers, fleets and OEM partners.
segments.evidence: We have determined that we operate in one operating and reportable segment and, as such, the leases and agreements with the Site Hosts are attributable to that segment.

revenueModel.text: Drivers, fleet operators and OEM partners pay for electricity delivered at the company's fast chargers and for related network, software and eXtend services.
revenueModel.evidence: EVgo sells electricity directly to drivers who access EVgo's publicly available networked chargers.
